description.value: The Mearns-McPherson Library is the main branch of UVic Libraries on the University of Victoria campus in Victoria, BC, serving students, researchers, alumni, and the broader community. The library offers study spaces, computer stations, media and making facilities, and houses the University Art Collections and Special Collections & University Archives. It is wheelchair accessible and sits on the traditional territory of the Lək̓ʷəŋən (Songhees and Xʷsepsəm/Esquimalt) Peoples.
